# 2 Baruch Chapter 38 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

This log records all verses in 2 Baruch Chapter 38 where the three translators (EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA) significantly diverged in their renderings, along with SOPHIA's resolution and reasoning.

---

## 38:2 — "few have been shown / few have been given to see"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "few-have-been-shown" | Literal passive of "show/reveal" |
| LOGOS | "few have been shown" | Formal equivalent |
| PNEUMA | "few have been shown" | Same — all three agree |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Consensus on "few have been shown." No divergence.

**Status:** Consensus.

---

## 38:4 — "most perfect law / most excellent law / perfect law"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the-most-perfect-[law]-of-the-Most-High" | Literal superlative; brackets "law" as implied |
| LOGOS | "the most excellent law of the Most High" | Formal — "most excellent" for the Syriac superlative |
| PNEUMA | "the perfect law of the Most High" | Simplifies superlative |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS "the most excellent law." Preserves the superlative force without EMET's bracket. PNEUMA's simple "perfect" loses the comparative dimension.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---
